scope: Read-only history/design trace for critical-slots-display Unallocated Equipment Display and VerticalSlotChip requirements; no UI/spec/test/build/server changes.
decisionBasis: The VerticalSlotChip contract was introduced on 2026-01-13, then the accepted 2026-09-09 customizer workbench baseline removed its CriticalSlotsTab import/use and routed production loadout through ResponsiveLoadoutTray. The canonical critical-slots-display text was not superseded after that baseline. Current production therefore does not omit a required active-workbench chip; the chip scenario describes an obsolete standalone/inline layout.

facts: UnitEditorWithRouting always passes workbench=true to UnitEditorWithRoutingTabContent.
UnitEditorWithRoutingTabContent passes hideLoadoutTray={!workbench}, so production CriticalSlotsTab receives false.
CriticalSlotsTab inline section is guarded by hideLoadoutTray && !workbench at lines 226-239; it is unreachable from the production workbench path.
ResponsiveLoadoutTray mounts GlobalLoadoutTray for desktop and drawer paths; mobile uses its loadout list.
GlobalLoadoutTray uses allocation sections/category groups; MobileLoadoutList has explicit Unassigned/Allocated collapsible sections and quick assignment.
activePath.conclusion: The current Button/span fallback at CriticalSlotsTab.tsx:95-111 is not the active production loadout authority. It is a standalone fallback path retained for non-workbench callers/tests.
